description: This file defines the AppDatabase class, an abstract RoomDatabase implementation, which manages the application's notes data. It includes singleton access via getInstance method and references the Note and NoteDao data entities.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Abstract database class for the notes app, providing access to the noteDao and singleton instance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the AppDatabase, creating it if necessary using Room.databaseBuilder.
